Develop standard templates and architectures at various power/energy levels to accelerate project scalability and repeatablility.   Validation & hardware-in-the-loop: Design, build, and operate hardware-in-the-loop test benches for controls validation ahead of hardware availability. Develop and maintain automated test frameworks (Python or equivalent) that improve test coverage, execution speed, and requirements traceability across programs. Execute lab validation on power hardware — converter bring-up, closed-loop performance characterization, fault and abnormal-condition testing — and drive resolution of issues found.   Cross-functional program execution: Partner with firmware, hardware, systems, and product engineering teams to close requirements, resolve interface issues, and support design reviews and gate milestones. Support pre-compliance system validation techniques in conjunction with UL and other standards bodies.   Engineering standards & continuous improvement: Establish and maintain validation standards — documentation templates, repository structure, model and test-case conventions — so that test practice is repeatable and not dependent on individual knowledge.
